newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan two-month NCD average yield at 6.882 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan two-month NCD average yield at 6.882 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$5 billion in two-month negotiable certificates of deposit on Saturday at an average yield of 6.882 percent, a central bank official said.
The range of the bids was between 6.75 and 6.98 percent.
The issue coincides with a long bull run in Taiwan's stock market, where the index has pushed to a series of seven-year highs in recent weeks.
On Saturday the index closed 71.90 points or 0.74 percent higher to another seven-year high 9,749.30, its highest level since April 12, 1990.
